verdict.rationale: The evidence implies an official catalog exists: developers can submit apps to the Microsoft Store and package them with MSIX. That shows a first-party distribution channel, but only from the developer side. Nothing documents the end-user install experience, the catalog's size, or power-user tooling. Missing for 10: documentation of users installing apps from the Store, evidence the catalog holds thousands of apps, power-user install paths (e.g. a command-line package manager), independent or hands-on corroboration.
